objective: Bring 6 Wavethrasher Scales to Ogtinc in Azshara.  Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.

description: The wavethrasher is an amphibious beast living only here in Azshara.  They are powerful and resilient.
The tough, reflective scales from a wavethrasher mirror the strength of the hunter.
Track and hunt wavethrashers along the coast of Azshara, and bring me their scales.
completion: The wavethrashers are not easily defeated, even more so in their watery environment.
You have proven yourself ready to hunt even deadlier prey.
